name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Horror
description: FNAF 1 horror in Minecraft: survive five nights in Freddy Fazbear's Pizza - cameras, doors, power, animatronics that hunt you, and a generator to refuel when the power runs out. Fan-made by Dead Signal Studio. FNAF 1 models by 999angry and map by skylajade69 (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0) - see assets/fnaf/CREDITS.txt.
